name: Berkeley Fall 2008
information:
Schedule: Registration opens at 9:00 am; competition starts at 9:30 am.
Registration fee: $5 for first event + $2 for each additional event if preregistered. If you are not preregistered, it will be $10 to register and only for the 3x3 speedsolve event.
Preregistration will be CLOSED November 8th.
